_source: Site-wide contact and company details, in one place. Read by website/_src/build.py (footer, Organization JSON-LD) and as {{site:...}} tokens in page fragments. The enquiry function (site/api/enquiry.js) cannot read this file at run time, so it repeats the email address; scripts/test_enquiry.js fails if the two differ.

registered_office._note: LEGAL QUESTION PENDING WITH THE PM — do not change without their instruction. This is the only place the address is written: change these two lines (English and Welsh forms of the same address) and rebuild. It appears in the footer of /funding/ and /cy/ffioedd-a-chyllid/ only.

legal._note: THE TRADING DISCLOSURE (Company, LLP and Business (Names and Trading Disclosures) Regulations 2015, regs 24-25), for the footer of every page once the showcase is on. One value each, used in both languages. Two are TODO_PM and the showcase CANNOT be switched public while either is: 'registered_in' must be copied verbatim from the Companies House record (never inferred from an address — the register could not be reached from the build machine on 20 Nov 2026), and 'registered_office' waits for Mark's decision on moving the registered office. The current registered office is a residential address and is NOT to be put here.

status.en: a community interest company and a limited company
status.cy: gwmni buddiant cymunedol ac yn gwmni cyfyngedig

salon_address._note: WHERE THE ACADEMY AND ITS SALON ARE. Stored once; read by the footer, the HairSalon JSON-LD and the 'Find us' block, in both languages. The unit number and the postcode are TODO_PM: the string below is the form the letting agents use for the park, with 'Unit N' standing in. While todo_pm is true the page shows the park and the town only, the JSON-LD carries no streetAddress or postalCode, and the page is noindex.

value.en: Unit N, St Asaph Business Park, Ffordd Richard Davies, St Asaph, LL17 0LJ
value.cy: Uned N, Parc Busnes Llanelwy, Ffordd Richard Davies, Llanelwy, LL17 0LJ
value.street: Unit N, St Asaph Business Park, Ffordd Richard Davies

confirmed_part.en: St Asaph Business Park, St Asaph, LL17

geo._note: Approximate centre of the business park. Replace with the unit's own pin.

find_us._note: Directions, parking and public transport. Drafted from the map, not from a visit: confirm each line on site before it is published.

en.road: By road, leave the A55 North Wales Expressway at junction 26, signed for St Asaph Business Park. The park is beside the junction.
en.parking: Parking at the unit is to be confirmed.
en.transport: The business park is on the edge of St Asaph, around a mile and a half from the city centre, and bus services to it are limited. Please check Traveline Cymru for current times before you rely on a bus. The nearest railway station is Rhyl.

cy.road: Ar y ffordd, gadewch Wibffordd Gogledd Cymru yr A55 wrth gyffordd 26, sydd ag arwyddion i Barc Busnes Llanelwy. Mae’r parc wrth ymyl y gyffordd.
cy.parking: Mae’r trefniadau parcio wrth yr uned i’w cadarnhau.
cy.transport: Mae’r parc busnes ar gyrion Llanelwy, tua milltir a hanner o ganol y ddinas, ac mae’r gwasanaethau bws iddo yn gyfyngedig. Gwiriwch Traveline Cymru am yr amseroedd cyfredol cyn dibynnu ar fws. Yr orsaf reilffordd agosaf yw’r Rhyl.
